subject: meteorite
title: A Meteorite Punched Through a Georgia Roof. It's Older Than Earth

scenes.text: A rock fell through a roof. It's older than Earth.
June 2025: a fireball streaked across the daytime sky over the Southeast.
A piece the size of a cherry tomato tore through a house near Atlanta and dented the floor.
It hit faster than the speed of sound, with a bang like a gunshot.
Scientists dated it to about 4.56 billion years, roughly 20 million years older than Earth.
It's leftover asteroid-belt rubble. The oldest thing in that house came through the roof.

description:
A meteorite that crashed through a home near McDonough, Georgia, in June 2025 is about 4.56 billion years old, roughly 20 million years older than Earth.
University of Georgia scientists found it is an ordinary chondrite from the main asteroid belt, linked to an asteroid breakup about 470 million years ago.
What would you do if a meteorite landed in your living room?
thumbnail_text: OLDER THAN EARTH. HIT A HOUSE
first_comment: It is only the 27th meteorite ever recovered in Georgia, and just the sixth anyone saw fall. Would you keep it or sell it?
